title: Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice
description: Spicy and hearty, this dish combines the flavors of Jamaica and Thailand.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Jamaican jerk seasoning to the chicken and stir to combine.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and seasoning.
Add the scallions, jalapeno peppers, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced jalapeno peppers and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Serve the jalapeno peppers and scallions on top of the fried rice.
